notes: Parameters of the population simulator (clinical_core/agere/simulator). kind = cited (a published effect with its evidence id and DOI), assumption (a planning input with a stated range; replace with the customer's contract or measured value) or derived (computed from the workspace's own data at run time; listed here only for documentation). Every distribution is uniform on [low, high] unless stated. Overrides: Workspace.simulate(..., parameters={'<id>': value | {value, low, high}}).

gdmt.combination_hr.outcome: CV death or HF hospitalization, quadruple therapy (ARNI + evidence-based beta blocker + MRA + SGLT2i) vs placebo
gdmt.combination_hr.source: van Essen et al., pharmacologic treatment of HFrEF: updated systematic review and network meta-analysis, JACC 2025 (N=103,754), doi:10.1016/j.jacc.2025.08.054
gdmt.combination_hr.provenance: Physician Builders evidence pack (phys-build-flow docs/synthetic-patients/evidence-requests/gdmt-outcomes-real-world.answer.md, support literature)
gdmt.combination_hr.use: The only combined multi-pillar effect. Adding all four pillars reproduces this value exactly.

gdmt.pillar_hr.rasi.use: Relative weight only: this pillar's share of the combined log hazard ratio. Never multiplied with the other pillars.

gdmt.pillar_hr.beta_blocker.source: MERIT-HF (Wikstrand, J Intern Med 2014 pooled analysis), doi:10.1111/joim.12141

gdmt.pillar_hr.mra.source: HFrEF MRA IPD meta-analysis, Lancet 2024, doi:10.1016/S0140-6736(24)01733-1

gdmt.pillar_hr.sglt2i.outcome: CV death or first HF hospitalization (pooled DAPA-HF + EMPEROR-Reduced)

gdmt.real_world_effect_fraction.why: Share of the trial effect realised in routine care (dose attainment, persistence). Registries report 11-14% of ARNI users at target dose at 12 months (ev:hf_arni_target_dose_12mo_champ, doi:10.1016/j.jacc.2018.04.070; ev:hf_arni_target_dose_12mo_evolution_us, doi:10.1016/j.jchf.2023.08.027).

gdmt.p_pillar_started_completed.why: Probability that each target pillar is started (filled) when the PharmD titration plan is completed.

gdmt.p_pillar_started_attended.why: Probability that each target pillar is started when the first pharmacist visit happened but the program was not completed.

gdmt.barrier_review.p_pillar_started_com.why: Barrier review re-verifies documented barriers (rechallenge, alternative agent, cost assistance) before outreach: fewer pillars start per completed review.

gdmt.barrier_review.p_pillar_started_att.why: As above, when the review visit happened but was not completed.

gdmt.fill_lag_days.why: Days from the first pharmacist visit to the first fill of a new pillar; the effect starts at that fill.

pt.back_pain_ed_rr.why: No cited effect of physical therapy after an ED low back pain visit on repeat back-pain ED visits is loaded in this repository. Range runs from no effect (the early-PT randomized trial in primary care found no significant difference in health care use at one year: Fritz et al., JAMA 2015) to a 30% reduction (observational early-PT cohorts). Replace with a cited value when one is loaded.

pt.back_pain_other_spend_rr.why: Effect on non-ED back-pain spending (imaging, injections, specialist visits) after PT. Assumption with a range; no cited value loaded.

pt.partial_effect_fraction.why: Share of the PT effect realised when the evaluation was attended but the program (evaluation + 4 sessions) was not completed.

pt.start_lag_days.why: Effect starts at the attended PT evaluation.

drug_cost_month.rasi.why: Pharmacy-benefit net cost of a RAS inhibitor; low end generic ACEi/ARB, high end branded ARNI. Outside the Medicare A/B benchmark.

drug_cost_month.mra.why: Generic spironolactone; eplerenone at the high end.

drug_cost_month.sglt2i.why: Branded SGLT2 inhibitor net of an unknown rebate.

per_outreach.why: pharmacy technician outreach per routed patient
PharmD chart review of documented barriers per routed patient

annual_allowed.source: CMS ACCESS Model Payment Amounts and Performance Targets (cms.gov/priorities/innovation/files/access-payments-amts-perf-targets.pdf), retrieved 2026-10-18
annual_allowed.why: MSK Initial Period allowed amount per beneficiary per year; no Follow-On Period

medicare_share.source: CMS ACCESS Model Payment Amounts and Performance Targets (cms.gov/priorities/innovation/files/access-payments-amts-perf-targets.pdf), retrieved 2026-10-18
medicare_share.why: allowed amount = Medicare 80% + beneficiary coinsurance 20% (participants may waive coinsurance)

withheld_share.source: CMS ACCESS Model Payment Amounts and Performance Targets (cms.gov/priorities/innovation/files/access-payments-amts-perf-targets.pdf), retrieved 2026-10-18
withheld_share.why: monthly payments capped at 50% of the Medicare portion; 50% withheld and reconciled after the care period

outcome_attainment_threshold.source: CMS ACCESS Model Payment Amounts and Performance Targets (cms.gov/priorities/innovation/files/access-payments-amts-perf-targets.pdf), retrieved 2026-10-18
outcome_attainment_threshold.why: full payment if >= 50% of aligned beneficiaries complete the care period and meet all OAP measure targets

p_target_met_if_completed.why: share of completers reaching the MSK targets (2-point PROMIS pain interference reduction and 2-point physical function increase)

below_threshold_rule.why: below the OAT the withheld half is paid in proportion to attainment / OAT; the exact Clinical Outcome Adjustment formula is in the RFA and is not modelled here

co_management_per_enrolled.source: Foley Hoag summary of the CMS ACCESS payment announcement (March 2026): approximately $30 co-management payment to PCPs/referring clinicians
co_management_per_enrolled.why: billed by the primary care or referring clinician

counts_in_aco_benchmark_from_year.why: no OAP impact on ACO benchmark/performance-year calculations in 2026-2027; included from 2028

per_attended.why: PT evaluation under the plan benefit

gdmt.label: HF-related (principal diagnosis I50) admissions and ED visits

pt.label: back-pain (principal diagnosis M54) ED visits and spending

forbidden.reason: Product of the four independent HFrEF pillar hazard ratios (0.79 x 0.66 x 0.63 x 0.74). Assumes independent, non-overlapping mechanisms; the trials had different comparators, eras and background therapy and the pillars share pathways.

contract.why: Settlement terms from the Agere program rulebook (config/agere/programs). The benchmark is contract-specific: by default it is the attributed population's projected do-nothing PMPM times benchmark_factor; pass contract={'benchmark_pmpm': ...} for the real one.
